title: SQL 基础练习
description: 通过具体示例练习 SQL 基础：查询、过滤、聚合、增删改与数据类型

content.content: SELECT * FROM users;
SELECT id, name, email FROM users;
SELECT name AS user_name, age AS user_age FROM users;
SELECT DISTINCT city FROM users;
SELECT DISTINCT city, country FROM users;
SELECT * FROM users WHERE age = 18;
SELECT * FROM users WHERE status <> 'active';
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE amount > 100;
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE amount <= 500;
SELECT * FROM users WHERE age >= 18 AND city = 'Beijing';
SELECT * FROM users WHERE city = 'Beijing' OR city = 'Shanghai';
SELECT * FROM users WHERE name LIKE 'Tom%';
SELECT * FROM products WHERE title LIKE '%phone%';
SELECT * FROM users WHERE id IN (1, 2, 3, 5);
SELECT * FROM users WHERE status NOT IN ('banned', 'deleted');
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE amount BETWEEN 100 AND 500;
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE created_at BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-03-31';
SELECT * FROM users WHERE email IS NULL;
SELECT * FROM users WHERE phone IS NOT NULL;
SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY age ASC;
SELECT * FROM orders ORDER BY created_at DESC;
SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY city ASC, age DESC;
SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 10;
SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY id LIMIT 20 OFFSET 40;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users;
SELECT COUNT(email) FROM users;
SELECT SUM(amount) FROM orders;
SELECT AVG(price) FROM products;
SELECT MAX(price), MIN(price) FROM products;
SELECT city, COUNT(*) FROM users GROUP BY city;
SELECT city, status, COUNT(*) FROM users GROUP BY city, status;
SELECT user_id, SUM(amount) AS total FROM orders GROUP BY user_id;
SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS c FROM users GROUP BY city HAVING c > 10;
SELECT user_id, SUM(amount) AS total FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' GROUP BY user_id HAVING total > 1000;
INSERT INTO users (name, age, email) VALUES ('Tom', 25, 'tom@example.com');
INSERT INTO users (name, age) VALUES ('Alice', 22), ('Bob', 30), ('Carol', 28);
UPDATE users SET status = 'active' WHERE id = 1;
UPDATE users SET name = 'Tom', age = 26 WHERE id = 1;
DELETE FROM users WHERE id = 1;
DELETE FROM users WHERE status = 'deleted';
CREATE TABLE products (id INT PRIMARY KEY, stock INT, price DECIMAL(10,2), rating FLOAT);
CREATE TABLE users (id INT, code CHAR(8), name VARCHAR(50), bio TEXT);
CREATE TABLE logs (id INT, log_date DATE, log_time DATETIME, created_at TIMESTAMP);
CREATE TABLE users (id INT, is_active TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 1);
